text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
That's my Trainer for ya!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you're my new partner starting today!
We'll fight together and defend justice!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
First, let me introduce the team.
This person is the Trainer—meaning the captain!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"She's also the benefactor who saved your life.
So, let's thank her together!
—Thank you, Captain!"
